Feel the romance of the 90s with “Dil Lagake Dekho” from Ghar Jamai (1992) starring Mithun Chakraborty and Varsha Usgaonkar. A soulful track filled with love and emotions, this song remains a cherished melody for Bollywood music lovers. Perfect for those who enjoy the magic of 90s romantic Hindi songs.
